    # Defensive defaults
    x = observation.get('position', [0, 0])[0] if isinstance(observation.get('position', []), (list, tuple)) else 0
    y = observation.get('position', [0, 0])[1] if isinstance(observation.get('position', []), (list, tuple)) else 0

    # Default target: stay or move minimally towards center-ish
    target_x = 0
    target_y = 0

    # Defensive field extraction for common observation shapes
    # Resource collection: look for nearest resource (rx, ry)
    try:
        resources = observation.get('resources', [])
        if resources:
            # pick closest resource if available
            rx, ry = resources[0].get('position', (0, 0))
            # compute simple delta to resource
            dx = int((rx - x) and (rx - x) / abs(rx - x) if rx != x else 0)
            dy = int((ry - y) and (ry - y) / abs(ry - y) if ry != y else 0)
            # Clamp to -1,0,1
            dx = max(-1, min(1, dx))
            dy = max(-1, min(1, dy))
            return [dx, dy]
    except Exception:
        pass

    # Pursuit/Evasion: if enemies present, try to move toward away from nearest evader for safety
    try:
        enemies = observation.get('enemies', [])
        if enemies:
            ex, ey = enemies[0].get('position', (0, 0))
            # If we are closer to center than enemy, move away; else slight adjustment toward center
            dx = 0
            dy = 0
            if ex > x:
                dx = -1
            elif ex < x:
                dx = 1
            if ey > y:
                dy = -1
            elif ey < y:
                dy = 1
            dx = max(-1, min(1, dx))
            dy = max(-1, min(1, dy))
            return [dx, dy]
    except Exception:
        pass

    # Territory control / exploration: move toward center of map if known
    try:
        center = observation.get('map_center', (0, 0))
        cx, cy = center
        dx = 0 if x == cx else (1 if cx > x else -1)
        dy = 0 if y == cy else (1 if cy > y else -1)
        dx = max(-1, min(1, dx))
        dy = max(-1, min(1, dy))
        return [dx, dy]
    except Exception:
        pass

    # Fallback: stay
    return [0, 0]
